questions.stem: A shape is enlarged by scale factor $3$ from a centre of enlargement. If a side of the original shape is $4\text{ cm}$, how long is the corresponding side on the image?
questions.explanation: Under an enlargement with scale factor $3$, every length is multiplied by $3$. So $4 \times 3 = 12\text{ cm}$.

questions.stem: A triangle is enlarged by scale factor $2$ from a centre of enlargement. What happens to the area of the triangle?
questions.explanation: When a shape is enlarged by scale factor $k$, the area is multiplied by $k^2$. With $k = 2$, the area is multiplied by $2^2 = 4$, so it quadruples.
